title.narrative: Laying the Foundations for Sustainable Investment Promotion through Improved utilization of Free Trade Agreements (FSIP)

description.narrative: The Project Laying the Foundations for Sustainable Investment Promotion through Improved Utilization of Free Trade Agreements (FSIP), to be implemented through this Initiation Plan, is an initiatory phase designed set the basis for the Strategic Sustainable Investment Promotion (SSIP) Project which has been proposed for financing and aims to ensure Serbia’s effective engagement in sustainable trade and investment under its newly signed Free Trade Agreements (with China, the UAE, and Egypt). Implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Economy, this project will focus on establishing the Pilot Sustainable Investment Promotion (SIP) Facility in China, where the FTA has already entered into force and represents a key opportunity for Serbian businesses. The activities implementing this IP will include market research and location assessment to identify the optimal city and premises for the SIP Facility, facility design and, branding, and alignment with investment promotion objectives, to create a fully operational business hub, as well as stakeholder engagement and fundraising efforts to introduce key stakeholders, attract investments, and mobilize resources for long-term sustainability of the Pilot SIP Facility.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
